# SensoryForge

> An extensible playground for simulating sensory encoding and generating population activity

Coding agents working in the repository start at [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/benefron/sensoryforge/blob/main/AGENTS.md).

- [Installation](https://benefron.github.io/sensoryforge/tutorials/installation/)
